mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above the prior quarter's median triggers a risk-off reaction, depressing near-term equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: early stage of a tightening cycle
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05) during confirmed tightening episodes.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent declines in the CPIAUCSL inflation index below 2% for three consecutive months signal disinflation, which reduces the Fed's policy rate hike expectations and supports equity valuations, leading to positive 60-day forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for the required window (out-of-sample t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in PAYEMS employment months after a positive payroll surprise indicates softening labor market strength, which reduces growth expectations and produces negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS < prev_month by > -2.0% in the month following a positive monthly payroll surprise
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during confirmed moderation episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sequential decline in both HOUST industrial production and RSAFS retail sales for two consecutive months signals weakening overall demand, which compresses earnings growth forecasts and drives negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite both proxies showing the required double decline (out-of-sample IC > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in INDPRO manufacturing index below trend for three consecutive months suggests supply-side headwinds, which elevates uncertainty and produces negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during confirmed supply shocks.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4% for two consecutive months signals tighter labor market conditions, which increases discount rates and dampens equity valuations, resulting in negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite UNRATE meeting or exceeding the threshold (out-of-sample IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in GDPC1 personal consumption and HOUST industrial production for one month followed by a month of stable or modest growth in both series indicate a mild soft landing, which supports risk-on sentiment and produces positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < prev_month and HOUST <= prev_month, then both >= prev_month in next month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative despite the pattern forming (out-of-sample IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A regime shift from monetary easing to a hold policy as signaled by FEDFUNDS stabilizing above 5% for two consecutive months produces a neutral-to-slightly-positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to reduced expectations of future rate cuts.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5.0 for 2 consecutive months and trend up
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite FEDFUNDS meeting the hold threshold (out-of-sample IC < 0.03).
